$comment: PRICING CONTRACT — the human-readable record of termio's pricing; the typed copy the landing site renders is web/landing/src/data/pricing.ts (keep them in sync). termio uses a one-time LIFETIME license (NO subscription): pay once, own it forever including all future updates, with a 30-day money-back guarantee and a 7-day no-account free trial. Two tiers by device count: Solo (1 Mac) and Pro (up to 3 Macs). Sold through Lemon Squeezy (Merchant of Record): Lemon Squeezy hosts checkout, remits global tax, and issues + validates the license keys (its License API enforces the per-tier device activation limit), so there is no self-hosted licensing backend.
